_comment: Seasonal offers announced by the JustFlip app (Today card, paywall label) and the homepage (#black-friday). The offer that started last and has no passed "end" is shown, so Black Friday hands over to Cyber Monday on its start, and Cyber Monday stays until you set its "end". "end": null means until further notice. theme: blackFriday | cyberMonday | anything else = generic special offer. The price itself is set in App Store Connect; the app only announces an offer while Lifetime costs at most maxPriceVsYearly x the Yearly price there (so a file live before the price is never shown in the app). To end the sale: set "end" on the running offer to an ISO date-time AND restore the price in App Store Connect on the same day.
